name: Life Foods Co.,Ltd.
summary: Life Foods Co., Ltd. manages restaurants serving traditional Japanese food under brands including Zameshiya, Machikadoya, Meshiya and Sanuki noodles, mainly in the Kansai and Chubu regions. Dating from 1981 as El Foods Co., Ltd., it took its present name in 1991. It has its headquarters in Suita, Japan, and belongs to the Seven & i Holdings Co., Ltd. group.
